description: Complete asset + source package for the Perchance AI Furry Generator: internal code, external code (all imports), third-party vendor libraries/fonts, project assets, documentation and tooling. Distributed as 4 zip parts (see parts / README-FIRST.md).

parts.note: A single archive exceeds the 100 MB per-file limit, so the package ships as 4 zips. Every part has the same top-level folder (ai-furry-generator-complete-package/), so extracting all four into one directory reconstructs the complete tree. The `part` field on each file says which zip it is in.

notIncluded.reason: multiple GB of individual emoji images

notIncluded.reason: produced per-user at runtime; the styles/prompts that drive them are included
